title: DeepSeek and Kimi return to Fireworks
summary:
DeepSeek and Kimi returned to their previous route, while the app catalog lost two dead links and the README gave contributors their due.

DeepSeek V3.2 and Kimi K2.5 were moved to a different provider, then switched back to Fireworks after the new route showed a reported failure rate of about 75%. Their public model names and aliases stayed the same. A separate Kontext configuration update was not reverted.

Genie AI and Marid V2.0 were removed after repeated checks found their links unavailable, so the catalog no longer sends visitors to those pages.

The README’s Recent Apps table now credits contributors instead of a generic account, including the makers of URV AI Chat and StoryBoard AI.
